title: Rebalance Patch
flavor: Autochess is encountering many problems due to Dota2 New Version, this Patch is trying to rebalance and fix bugs.

entries.name: (Keep up with Dota2) Pure Damage cannot have lifesteal
Damage dealt by summoned units and illusions will be counted as their owners’ damage and restore mana for their owner
Due to Dota2 Precache problems, all Arcana decorations are removed to ensure loading stability. We made our best effort to redecorate all the chess pieces with nice looks
Now Relic will be shown in item slots due to Dota2 New Mechanism
Muerta - Pierce the Veil
entries.detail: Extra magical damage removed, duration decreased from 2.5/3/4s to 2/3/4s, chance for double shot decreased from 30%/40%/50% to 20%/30%/40%

entries.name: Soul Breaker - Greater Bash
entries.detail: Chances for stun increased from 15%/25%/40% to 20%/30%/50%, extra damage decreased from 100/150/250 to 100/150/200

entries.name: Tiny
entries.detail: HP instead from 550 to 600 but removed HP of Growth. Armor increased from 3 to 5, magical resistance increased from 0% to 20%

entries.name: Luna
entries.detail: HP increased from 550 to 600, base damage increased from 60 to 65

entries.name: Morphling
entries.detail: HP increased from 450 to 550, armor decreased from 3 to 2, magical resistance increased from 0% to 10%

entries.name: Beastmaster - Call of the Wild
entries.detail: Summoned beasts’ attack interval increased from 1.2/1.2/1.2s to 1.4/1.4/1.6s

entries.name: Phantom Assassin
entries.detail: HP increased from 550 to 600, armor increased from 4 to 5

entries.name: Terrorblade
entries.detail: HP increased from 650 to 700, demonic terrorblades’ HP decreased from 850/1700/3400 to 700/1400/2800, attack damage increased from 55 to 60, demonic terrorblades’ attack damage increased from 110/180/290 to 80/160/320, attack interval increased from 1s to 1.1s

entries.name: Monkey King - Jingu Mastery
entries.detail: Boundless Strike’s damage multiplier decreased from 150%/200%/250% to 150%/175%/200%

entries.name: Disruptor - Static Storm
entries.detail: Radius increased from 300/400/500 to 400/450/500, cd decreased from 25/15/10s to 20/15/10s

entries.name: Spectre
entries.detail: Haunt’s damage multiplier increased from 2 to 2.5

entries.name: Warlock - Chaotic Offerings
entries.detail: Inferno’s base damage decreased from 200 to 150

entries.name: Ringmaster - Spotlight
entries.detail: Damage percentage on non-permanent pieces decreased from 20%/30%/40% to 为15%/20%/30%

entries.name: Orc - Battle Hardened
entries.detail: (4) Orcs - Max HP bonus increased from 300 to 400

entries.name: Shaman - Hex
